CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sgp_pdt_registro_fuentes_v4(p_token text, p_origen text, p_contexto jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '45s'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'contract_version',4,'fuentes',sgp_pdt_multiorigen.fuentes(p_token,p_origen,p_contexto));
$function$
